scripts.mock: concurrently -k -n bot,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run mock -w bot" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bot,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w bot" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w bot && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w bot && npm run typecheck -w web
